config.design: Fit centered PCA only on native normalized contexts of first four lexical pairs, grouped across all families to exclude lexical leakage. Project test context using fixed bases; retain exact recipient displacement and quadratic term. All output metrics evaluated against exact perturbed model.
metrics: KL(exact perturbed distribution || approximate perturbed distribution)
KL ratio to zero MLP response baseline
config.scope: Retrospective split on previously inspected prompts; withheld from fitting, not prospective fresh evidence. Only local context modulation compressed, not full MLP or downstream circuit. PCA optimizes context reconstruction, not response or KL.
